page.layout: One page of running text in a single column. Running head at top, centred, with the page number at top right. No marginal notes. Catchword at the lower right.

main_text.p: comitiis proponenda & agenda biduo anté comitiorum initium inscriptis exhiberi pos-sit duplici exemplo, altero in oppidanorum, altero in agrariorum usum : ut comitiorum decreta in mundum relata & oppidanis & a-grariis tradantur : manu suâ subsignet acta & epistolas collegii; scribæ à secretis instet, ne is officio usquam desit, sed omnia collegii acta, decreta, literas in volumen redigat : sigilli quoque custos sit, eoque recte utatur: extraordinarios sumptus collegium ne faciat, non ædificet, dona tribuat, pensiones assi-gnet, munia nova instituat, sine consensu, aut jussu Ordinum, eorumve, qui ab iis pote-statem habent: denique cum generalibus Or-dinibus, qui Hagæ sedem habent, & cum Ordinum eorundem senatu, adeoque cum iis, qui rebus maritimis præsident, consiliorum consociationem habeat: Reliqua sunt de cu-rarum & laborum, quos pro Rep. sustinent, præmiis. page.notes: Ink smudges at the right edge near the last lines; no words lost as far as readable. Long s rendered as plain s throughout; u/v normalised by vowel/consonant use. Running head "Vrbe" read as Urbe. The first line begins mid-sentence, so the paragraph is marked as continued from the previous page.
